decisions.reasonEn: One integrated field-survey outcome characterises a community with its abiotic site conditions using comparable original sampling. Hypothesis,careful conduct,qualitative/quantitative records and correlation limits form that same field result. Identification is an actual prerequisite;controlled effect testing and habitat judgement are separate.
decisions.distinctFromOtherGoals: Produces community/site survey evidence,not taxonomic skill certification or a causal suitability ranking.
